property_summary: For every interface id queried, C.supportsInterface returns true exactly for the IAccessControl id and the IERC165 id (ERC165 fallback); the mutant drops the super fallback, so it returns false when the IERC165 id is queried, breaking the biconditional.
change_summary: Return only the IAccessControl check, dropping the super.supportsInterface(IERC165) fallback so IERC165 queries return false.
